newsitem.title: INDIA: Eight guerrillas, two soldiers killed in India.
newsitem.headline: Eight guerrillas, two soldiers killed in India.

text.p: Eight separatist guerrillas and two Indian soldiers were killed in clashes in the northeastern state of Manipur, police said on Sunday.
Eight tribal militants were killed in a gunbattle on Saturday with security forces in Seram village, police in the state capital Imphal told Reuters by telephone.
Authorities arrested nine guerrillas and recovered a large quantity of arms and ammunition.
In a separate clash in Churachandpur district on Saturday, insurgents killed two soldiers and wounded three others, police told Reuters in the capital of Assam state, Guwahati.
Separatist tribal guerrillas are fighting for an independent homeland in mountainous Manipur, which shares a border with Burma, and blame the federal government for neglecting the region's economy.
